title: Fasting Plan Completion Rate
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`faith:rosary`), retreat events (`faith:retreat`), attendance logs (`faith:attendance`), fasting journals (`faith:fast`), practice reviews (`faith:ops`).
app: Spiritual-practice telemetry — rosary counters, meditation-retreat schedules, church-attendance logs, and fasting journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=faith:fast fast_type=* completed=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(completed="yes",1,0))) as matched by fast_type
| eval a_completed_fast_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_completed_fast_pct
description: Measures the percentage of fasting plans that end with a completed fast by fast type.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which fast type are helping or hurting fasting plans.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a completed fast` on `faith:fast` events and summarize the hit rate by `fast_type`.
visualization: Table of fast type with percentage of fasting plans ending with a completed fast.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors how often a completed fast happens for each fast type so you can see where fasting plans go smoothly or get stuck.
